database_limit: Commander Spellbook is incomplete, especially for new cards. No-match records are evidence, not proof of absence.
notes: Every record below is tied to the exact current deck hash, a 2026-08-30 full-list Commander Spellbook scan, and a manual prerequisite review of the returned candidates and newer cards.

decks.summary: The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Manual review found no loop among Selvala, Devoted Druid, Pip-Boy 3000, Bear Umbra, or the Equipment-copy package; the deck's sharp finishes remain finite commander-damage attacks.
The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Free Equipment movement, token doubling, and Bloodforged Battle-Axe scaling are strong but finite in the current 100.

Commander Spellbook returned the Mikaeus and Viscera Seer template, but the exact list has no qualifying persist creature. Manual review of the death, blitz, and reanimation package found no replacement that closes the loop.

lines.reason: No creature with persist is present in the current 100.

decks.summary: The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Dwarven Bloodboiler, Relic of Legends, crew effects, Maskwood Nexus, and Roaming Throne create or double a finite number of Magda triggers because the deck has no repeatable untap engine.

The refreshed exact-list scan returned no included combo. Illusionist's Bracers, Sting, and Roaming Throne multiply Rat production at bounded turn and combat events; the Thornbite and ripple loops remain absent.

The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, and Blasting Station convert Illusions into finite value; Homunculus Horde and Krang multiply second-draw triggers but do not retrigger the same draw event or recur a sacrificed token.

All three returned Apex Altisaur and Wrathful Raptors lines are present. They clear opposing creatures and can deal near-infinite damage when opposing bodies keep Apex Altisaur's fight chain going; Savage Order is the compact tutored version and is the list's main Bracket 3 disclosure.

Commander Spellbook returned the finite Fire Covenant and Brash Taunter kill. Manual review also found a real but expensive five-card Arcbond loop: copy Arcbond onto Selfless Squire, make both it and Brash Taunter indestructible, then have Brash fight the Squire. The two delayed triggers feed each other while the Squire prevents damage to you.

lines.reason: Copy Arcbond so Brash Taunter and Selfless Squire each have its delayed trigger, give both indestructible, and activate Brash Taunter to fight the Squire. Each Arcbond trigger damages the other creature and creates the next trigger; Selfless Squire prevents the damage to you while opponents take every iteration.

decks.summary: The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Manual review found that Banishing Knack and Retraction Helix lack a free recast and untap engine, Basking Broodscale lacks a counter-removal loop, and the creature untappers produce bounded activations. The deck remains a finite tap, untap, counter, and Vehicle engine.
